title: Catalog Metadata Correction Backlog
dataSources: Release events (`music:distribution`), Bandcamp activity (`music:bandcamp`), project exports (`music:project`), streaming analytics (`music:streaming`), metadata tasks (`music:ops`).
app: Music-making and creator telemetry — DistroKid release exports, Bandcamp sales activity, Cockos Reaper project stats, and Spotify for Artists analytics — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs, exports, and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=music:ops store_name=* metadata_state=*
| stats sum(eval(if(metadata_state!="clean",1,0))) as backlog, count as total by store_name
| where backlog>0
| sort - backlog
description: Lists pending metadata fixes backlog by store for catalog operations.
value: Backlog counts expose where small unfinished tasks accumulate and create hidden drag inside catalog operations.
implementation: Mark each `music:ops` record with a pending-state flag and summarize backlog totals by `store_name`.
visualization: Table of store with pending metadata fixes counts.
grandmaExplanation: It celebrates where unfinished metadata fixes are piling up so you can clear the biggest queues in catalog operations.
